description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Toast creates technology that helps restaurants and local businesses operate, grow sales, engage customers, and improve guest experiences. The Software Engineer I, Websites will build and enhance full-stack web solutions for Toast’s website builder and online ordering products, collaborating with Design, Product, and engineering teams while leveraging AI tools to improve development productivity.
Software engineer building and enhancing customer-facing websites, improving performance, usability, and platform scalability

Responsibilities:
• Design, scope, and implement cutting-edge solutions using a mix of technologies
• Enhance the platform to boost performance, usability, and scalability
• Collaborate closely with Design and Product stakeholders to ensure we are building the right solutions to the right problems
• Identify high-impact opportunities with your team and turn them into reality
• Be an awesome teammate who’s all in on collaboration and collective success
• Work across teams to ensure that every part of our product ecosystem works seamlessly together to deliver the best possible experience for our customers
• Leverage cutting edge AI tools to enhance your development workflow, improve velocity, and help pioneer new approaches to building - contributing to a culture of innovation and productivity across the team

Requirements:
• Experienced in developing full stack web applications
• Experience with backend technologies like Node.js and Java/Kotlin
• Skilled with web fundamentals like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Experienced with tools like Docker, Git, Bash/ZSH
• Thrive in a collaborative, team-based environment where you ship features together
• Passionate about writing testable and clean code, with experience in API design and unit/integration testing
• Passionate about making users happy and seeing people use your product in the wild
• Embrace the agile mindset—ship quickly, iterate, and refine

Preferred:
• Familiarity with frontend frameworks like React or Angular, and CSS frameworks like Tailwind or Bootstrap is a plus
